nodes.long_description:
1. take out the vivarium box
2. place the vivariums on the four scales on both arms
3. place a glass tube on the right two-armed scale
4. shrink down and enter the portal to the right side of the left scale
5. make a fire
6. go outside through the portal 
7. observe the left scale from outside.
8. enter the open portal to the right
9. start a fire
10. use the portal to go outside.
11. go outside and observe the scales on both arms
<Result 
- Burning wood, charcoal, and candles: Burning wood, charcoal, and candles produces water vapor and carbon dioxide.
nodes.short_description: Explore the fundamental principle of mass conservation in chemical reactions. This experiment demonstrates that the mass of reactants equals the mass of products, a cornerstone concept in chemistry.

nodes.long_description: "Dive into the realm of realistic experiments through Virtual Reality (VR). Experience the excitement of conducting actual reactions in a risk-free digital laboratory. Mix substances, observe genuine changes, and engage with lifelike molecular structures—all in an immersive 3D environment. Enhance your learning by interacting with accurate representations of laboratory equipment and substances, all while honing your scientific skills. Explore the world of chemistry in an unprecedented way, where hands-on experimentation meets cutting-edge technology for an educational adventure like no other.
